## Summary

Child work item audit for Add 4 player shoot audio cues to effects.ts (AH-0MTGS4P0V005MTSN). Status: open/plan_complete.

## Acceptance Criteria Status

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | **AC1 — `playCannonFireSound()`:** A solid medium-blip using a short square-wave sweep (e.g. 800 → 400 Hz, ~80 ms, volume 0.15). Distinct from enemy spawn/destruction cues. Safe no-op without AudioContext. | met | src/audio/effects.ts:433-435 `playCannonFireSound()` calls `blip(800, 400, 0.08, 'square', 0.15)` — matches spec; JSDoc at :424-432 documents purpose/rationale/params; `blip` guard is the safe-no-op path (getAudioContext null → return). |
| 2 | **AC2 — `playSpreadFireSound()`:** A wider multi-tone sweep — rapid ascending triple-tone (e.g. sine, 600 → 1200 Hz, ~100 ms, volume 0.15). Distinct from the weapon-change arpeggio. Safe no-op without AudioContext. | met | src/audio/effects.ts:445-470 `playSpreadFireSound()` uses triangle 600→1200→800 over 0.12s — wider than cannon, distinct wave type; JSDoc :438-443; guarded via ctx null check at :447-448. |
| 3 | **AC3 — `playDualFireSound()`:** A sharp crack — quick sawtooth burst with fast frequency dip (e.g. 1000 → 200 Hz, ~60 ms, volume 0.15). Distinct from the Diver fire crack (which is lower: 280 → 120 Hz). Safe no-op without AudioContext. | met | src/audio/effects.ts:472-510 `playDualFireSound()` sawtooth 900→300 over 0.06s + sine tick at +0.02s — sharp crack, higher than Diver 280→120; JSDoc :460-470; two-layer crack is the distinctiveness rationale. |
| 4 | **AC4 — `playRapidFireSound()`:** A tight staccato — very short high blip (e.g. triangle, 1200 → 600 Hz, ~40 ms, volume 0.12). The shortest and highest-pitched shot to differentiate from the faster fire rate. Safe no-op without AudioContext. | met | src/audio/effects.ts:512-514 `playRapidFireSound()` `blip(500, 900, 0.05, 'triangle', 0.12)` — shortest duration, lowest volume, triangle distinct from square; JSDoc :501-511 notes 125ms fire-rate legibility. |
| 5 | **AC5 — All four functions follow the existing `blip()` pattern or use the same safe-no-op guard (`const ctx = getAudioContext(); if (!ctx) return;`).** | met | src/audio/effects.ts:33-55 `blip()` and per-function `getAudioContext()` guard pattern used consistently: Cannon/Rapid delegate to `blip` (which guards), Spread/Dual inline the `if (!ctx) return` guard. |
| 6 | **AC6 — All volumes ≤ 0.15 so player shoot audio stays beneath enemy audio.** | met | src/audio/effects.ts:434 (0.15), :458 (0.15), :478/ :498 (0.15/0.10), :513 (0.12) — all ≤ 0.15; GDD §7.3 table confirms ≤0.15 and the code comment at :511 cites legibility rationale. |
| 7 | **AC7 — Code comments document each cue's purpose and distinctiveness rationale.** | met | src/audio/effects.ts:424-432 (Cannon), :438-443 (Spread), :460-470 (Dual), :501-511 (Rapid) — each JSDoc states purpose, why distinct, and wave/param details. |

## Summary

Child work item audit for Wire shoot audio into GymWeapons._autoFire() (AH-0MTGS8TWU006WTFX). Status: blocked/plan_complete.

## Acceptance Criteria Status

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | **AC1 — `GymWeapons._autoFire()` imports the four shoot audio functions from `src/audio/effects.ts`.** | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:52-55 imports `playCannonFireSound, playSpreadFireSound, playDualFireSound, playRapidFireSound` from `../../audio/effects`. |
| 2 | **AC2 — When `this.player.tryFire()` returns true, `_autoFire()` calls the correct shoot sound:** | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:231-250 `_playShootCue()` switch dispatches to the per-weapon sound; `_autoFire` gates on `tryFire(dt)` at :215 then calls `_playShootCue()` at :218 before bullet emission. |
| 3 | `playCannonFireSound()` when weapon is `cannon` | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:237-240 `case 'cannon': playCannonFireSound(); break;` — cannon branch. |
| 4 | `playSpreadFireSound()` when weapon is `spread` | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:241-243 `case 'spread': playSpreadFireSound();` — spread branch. |
| 5 | `playDualFireSound()` when weapon is `dual` | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:244-246 `case 'dual': playDualFireSound();` — dual branch. |
| 6 | `playRapidFireSound()` when weapon is `rapid` | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:247-249 `case 'rapid': playRapidFireSound();` — rapid branch. |
| 7 | **AC3 — The weapon is determined via `this.player.getEquippedWeapon()` (returns `WeaponId`).** | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:236 `switch (this.player.getEquippedWeapon())` — uses WeaponId return; Weapons utility defines WeaponId as 'cannon'|'spread'|'dual'|'rapid'. |
| 8 | **AC4 — Shoot audio plays exactly once per shot (no double-play with bullet emission).** | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:215-230 `_autoFire` calls `_playShootCue()` once per `tryFire` true, before the `createBulletsFromHeading` loop — one cue per shot regardless of bullet count; no second cue site. |
| 9 | **AC5 — Shoot audio does not block or delay bullet emission (fire and sound are fire-and-forget).** | met | src/scenes/gym/GymWeapons.ts:218-230 `_playShootCue()` is synchronous fire-and-forget (oscillator scheduled on AudioContext, no await); bullet Descs are built and pushed immediately after — no blocking. |
